en_US.plugin_description: Search installed games from Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft Connect, EA, Battle.net, Xbox, and itch.io.
en_US.error_launch_failed: Unable to launch the game. See the Wox log for details.
en_US.tool_list_installed_games: List installed games. An optional query filters by name.
en_US.tool_launch_game: Launch an installed game by its id, such as steam:570 or epic:AppName.

zh_CN.plugin_description: 搜索 Steam、Epic、GOG、Ubisoft Connect、EA、Battle.net、Xbox 和 itch.io 里已安装的游戏。
zh_CN.error_launch_failed: 游戏启动失败，请查看 Wox 日志了解详情。
zh_CN.tool_list_installed_games: 列出已安装的游戏。可以按名字过滤。
zh_CN.tool_launch_game: 按游戏编号启动已安装的游戏，例如 steam:570 或 epic:AppName。
